title: buddleja campestris
intro: Buddleja campestris, commonly known as the desert or coastal butterfly bush, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Buddleja campestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects.
